summary: Compass Diversified Holdings (NYSE: CODI) filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing a regular quarterly cash dividend on its three series of preferred shares. The distribution covers the period from July 30, 2026 through, but excluding, October 30, 2026, and is payable October 30, 2026 to all holders of record as of October 15, 2026. The preferred series carry stated rates of 7.250% (Series A) and 7.875% (Series B and C). No board recommendation, advisor, or structural or deal terms are disclosed. This is an ordinary distribution notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle arises.
